verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State is a government business-filing and records agency, not an automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it hosts user-defined automations; its documents cover filings, receipts, copies, and fees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
